description: ACTION -> REACTION library (CB 2026-11-19: 'chaque action possède une réaction... de vraies conséquences'). tools/plan_check.py matches every planned action against the triggers and refuses a plan whose action lists no reaction, no lasting consequence, no micro-animation or no sound. New recipes are added every time a production meets a new action (rule: a problem solved once becomes a recipe for every next video).

reactions: splash sheets thrown sideways from each wheel (arcs, 0.3-0.6 s)
droplets falling back with small rings on the puddle
the puddle surface ripples and rocks for 1-2 s
spray mist behind the car in backlight
consequences: car body and wheels WET: darker, glossier lower half, drips from the sills for 2-3 s
wet tyre tracks on the dry road that fade
the puddle is smaller / emptier afterwards
micro: car dips slightly as the front wheels enter
a few drops hit the lens or a nearby object
recipes.build: rc.vfx splash sheets (mesh arcs + instanced droplets, seeded), puddle = water plane with keyed ripple displacement, wet = keyed mix to a darker low-roughness material + wet-track decal fading

reactions: the vehicle pitches and bounces back, the hit object breaks or is thrown on a ballistic path
debris, shards and dust cloud
camera shake on the impact frame
consequences: dented panel (shape key), cracked / broken glass, bent parts, steam or smoke from the engine
debris left on the ground, skid marks before the impact
the hit object stays broken (no reset)
micro: wipers / antenna wobble, a hubcap rolls away, door swings
recipes.build: rc.physics (crash ballistic, deform shape keys, glass), rc.vfx dust/steam, shake() on lens shift; checked: launch < 1.5 m, speed < 15 m/s

reactions: nose dives, tyres smoke, the car slides
dust or rubber smoke trail
consequences: black skid marks stay on the road
smell-smoke drifts away
recipes.build: keyed pitch on the rig, skid decal curves (fill BOTH) growing with the slide, rc.vfx smoke

reactions: wheels turn at the ground speed, suspension bob
dust kicked up on dirt / spray on wet road, leaves swirl in its wake
consequences: tyre tracks on soft ground
micro: exhaust puff, antenna sway, reflections slide over the body
recipes.build: rc.animate vehicle_drive (wheel spin = distance / radius), rc.vfx dust trail on dirt

reactions: foot plants (no sliding), small dust puff on dirt / sand, splash ring on water, grass bends
consequences: footprints on sand, mud, snow
micro: body bob, arm swing, a breath
recipes.build: motion library walk/run, card feet snapped to the ground, footprint decals on soft ground

reactions: anticipation crouch, spring, airborne arc, landing squash
dust puff / splash / gravel scatter at the landing spot
consequences: prints or displaced gravel at the landing spot
micro: arms swing up, hat or hair lifts, settle after landing
sfx: thud of the landing on the surface
recipes.build: motion library jump/joy (21 f cycle: crouch +1..+6, air +7..+18, land +19); card on an arc; contact shadow stays on the ground

reactions: both hands go TO the item, grip, then it moves WITH the hands (never pops)
the hidden face / hair is revealed progressively
consequences: the item is held (under the arm, in the hand) or put down somewhere visible
micro: head tilt, hair spring, a shake of the head
recipes.build: 3D item follows the drawn head then the hands (tools/card_anchors.py), max 12 cm per frame, same scale throughout

reactions: the door swings on its hinge (ease out, small overshoot)
light changes through the opening, dust swirl
consequences: door stays in its new state
recipes.build: hinge reparent with view_layer.update before (lesson shot 1), keyed rotation with overshoot

reactions: cracks spread from the hit point then shards burst out and fall, glints
consequences: broken frame with jagged edge, shards on the ground
recipes.build: rc.physics glass (Voronoi, fixed seed, view_layer.update per cut), stone kinematic

reactions: falls with gravity, bounces with decreasing height, rolls / settles
dust puff on contact
consequences: object stays where it lands, possibly dented or open
recipes.build: rc.physics drop (rigid body bake converted to keys)

reactions: hand reaches, the object follows the hand from contact on (no teleport)
consequences: the place where it was is empty, maybe a dust mark
micro: slight weight dip of the arm
recipes.build: prop follows card hand (index.json hands) from the contact frame

reactions: staves burst at the hit point, contents spill (sand / water / liquid), hoops roll away
consequences: broken staves on the ground, a pile or puddle of the contents
micro: a hoop spins and falls flat
recipes.build: BREAK: barrel replaced by its own pieces at the same place and frame (continuity allows it), rc.physics + rc.vfx

reactions: flash, fireball, shockwave ring on the ground, debris flying, smoke column
camera shake, lights flicker
consequences: scorch mark, burning pieces, smoke that lingers
recipes.build: rc.vfx explosion_stylized (purely visual), fire meshes, smoke

reactions: flames flicker, light flickers on nearby surfaces, smoke rises, embers
consequences: blackened surfaces, ash
recipes.build: rc.vfx fire (cartoon mesh flames + embers) + flickering point light

reactions: stream with the right thickness, splash where it lands, spreading puddle
consequences: puddle / stain stays, container emptier
recipes.build: curve stream + growing puddle plane

reactions: leaves, grass, flags, hair and clothes move in the same direction, dust swirls
consequences: light objects displaced
recipes.build: rc.animate wind on vegetation + cloth sim baked to keys

reactions: streaks, splash rings on puddles, wet shine on everything
consequences: puddles grow, surfaces darker and glossier
micro: characters hunch, drops on the lens
recipes.build: rc.vfx rain + wet material switch

reactions: anticipation, impact, body falls with arms out, bounce, dust
consequences: lies or sits on the ground, dirty patch on the clothes, bump / stars
recipes.build: motion library fall/*, dust at contact

reactions: fans stand up, arms up, flags wave, confetti
consequences: confetti stays on the ground
recipes.build: instanced crowd with per-instance phase offsets

reactions: car shakes, exhaust puff, headlights on
consequences: idle vibration continues
recipes.build: keyed rig vibration + smoke puff

reactions: sparks jet from the contact, bounce and die out, light on surfaces
consequences: scratch marks on the metal / road
recipes.build: rc.vfx sparks (instanced points on ballistic arcs, emissive)

reactions: pieces tumble and fall at different speeds, catch the light
consequences: confetti stays on the ground and on shoulders
micro: foreground pieces blur past the lens
recipes.build: instanced cards with linear keys (shot 2)

reactions: the face changes ON the word with a 5-frame head pop
the body answers the face (lean back, shoulders up, freeze)
consequences: the emotion stays until the next beat (sweat drop, blush, veins)
sfx: sting or comic accent on the word
recipes.build: card faces k:<emotion> on the narration word (tracks.json acts), head pop by film.js tween.pop

reactions: the hand leads, the arm follows, the pose holds while the narration lands
anyone watching looks at the hand
consequences: the pose sets up the next beat
recipes.build: motion library gesture move in the character's single view (moves blend only inside one view)

reactions: bills burst out and flutter down, spinning, catching the light
the character's eyes turn into dollar signs
consequences: a pile of bills stays on the ground / in the car
bills stuck on objects
micro: single bills drifting past the lens
recipes.build: instanced bill cards with seeded ballistic + flutter keys; pile = instanced scatter on the ground

reactions: wood chips fly at each blow, the tree leans then crashes down, leaves and dust burst
consequences: a STUMP stays (and can be hit later), the trunk lies on the ground
recipes.build: trunk rig keyed on a hinge at the cut, chips instanced, stump separate object

reactions: water pours in, the boat lists and settles lower each shot, bubbles
consequences: the boat is gone, debris and a slick float on the water
recipes.build: keyed list/sink on the rig, water plane with foam ring, floating debris

reactions: body tumbles, clothes and hair flap in the wind, cheeks ripple
others fall around, clouds rush past
consequences: landing leaves a crater / a crushed haystack / broken branches
recipes.build: card on a falling path + fast camera follow, cloth/hair flap via moves, cloud layers streaming

reactions: vision blurs and darkens to black
waking: a blurry POV that focuses
consequences: he is somewhere else when he wakes (time jump)
recipes.build: compositor blur + vignette keyed to black, POV camera, focus pull on wake

reactions: flames burst from the engine, black smoke column, heat light on everything around
consequences: burnt shell, scorch marks, smoke lingering
recipes.build: rc.vfx fire meshes + smoke + flicker light; burnt material switch

reactions: big splash crown, spray, waves ring out, ice breaks
consequences: the vehicle / person sinks or floats, wet and shivering afterwards (blue face)
recipes.build: splash crown mesh + instanced droplets + wave rings

reactions: muzzle flash, recoil, sparks and dust where it hits
consequences: holes / pellets in the wall, smoke wisps
recipes.build: emissive flash card 2 frames, recoil keys, impact sparks

reactions: fuse sparks, flash, dust cloud fills the tunnel, debris
consequences: when the dust clears the hidden thing is revealed (glowing gold vein), rubble on the floor
micro: dust settling, small stones still falling
recipes.build: rc.vfx explosion + dust volume that fades to reveal a pre-built glowing object

reactions: the face changes ON the word to an exaggerated drawing (red eyes + veins, dollar eyes, blue face, chattering teeth)
a world effect answers (red cracks glow on the floor, steam from the ears, frost)
consequences: the effect fades but marks stay (cracks on the floor)
recipes.build: card face from the cast faces + vfx decal / cracks mesh with emissive
recipes.seen_in: pink_prison 27 s, crash_instinct 29 s, plane_fall 46 s

reactions: thick stream, swirl where it lands, colour spreads
consequences: the mix changes colour, drips on the rim and the table
recipes.build: curve stream + animated swirl texture, top-down insert shot

reactions: the number changes on the beat (7 → 0, 4:59 → 4:58), flashes
consequences: the final number stays on screen
recipes.build: text decal swapped per frame range on an emissive display mesh (the swap IS the action of the display)
recipes.seen_in: crash_instinct 9-11 s, whale_boat 13-15 s, dashcam 33 s
